rows.conditions: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw . Regular Wood can be harvested from Forest trees , vanity trees , Living Trees , and Underground Cabins in underground or cavern layers, as well as by using the Faecorn . Forest trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of regular grass or Mowed grass above surface , and vanity trees can be cultivated by placing Sakura Sapling or Yellow Willow Sapling on top of any grass (but yields Ebonwood or Shadewood instead if placed on Corrupt or Crimson grass variants).

Some Wood types are found placed in other forms. For example, Underground Cabins generally use Wood corresponding to their biome (i.e. Rich Mahogany in the Jungle, Boreal in the Snow biome, regular Wood basically everywhere else). Living Trees and Living Mahogany Trees are made of Living Wood and Rich Mahogany, respectively.

Magic Mirrors can be found in Chests generated in the Underground and Cavern layers. Ice Mirrors can be found in Frozen Chests generated in the Ice biome . Newly created characters in Journey Mode (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) spawn with a Magic Mirror.

It can be crafted from Vile Mushrooms or purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each during a Blood Moon in a Corrupt world.
